_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Software Metrics
summary: Provides the status of the software effort on an acquisition program and is used by the software development lead to manage resources and execution on a software development effort.
use_relationship:
Software metrics provides the status of the software effort on an acquisition program and is used by the software development lead to manage resources and execution on a software development effort.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use for the data product resulting from the work task described in the contract Statement of Work/Performance Work Statement.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Referenced documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

children.title: Standard Work Package SWP4940-024 Software Measurement Plan Template

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The deliverable shall be in contractor format unless tailored out in the Contract Data Requirements List (CDRL) (DD 1423).

preparation_instructions.title: Contents
preparation_instructions.content: Metrics shall be evaluated as part of the software engineering processes applied. These metrics shall be tailored, when appropriate, to reflect the scope of the software change, and be in compliance with NAVAIR SWP 4140-024. These metrics shall ensure software quality, maturity, and stability does not negatively deviate from demonstrated performance thresholds.

children.title: Document Management
children.content: This section shall identify the version, release date, and other relevant management and configuration control information associated with the current version of the deliverable. A change history, highlighting significant changes from version to version shall be included.

children.title: Table of Contents
children.content: This section shall index all sections, major paragraphs, subparagraphs and appendices with page numbers.

children.title: Scope
children.content: This section shall be divided into paragraphs system overview and document overview.

children.title: System Overview
children.content: This section shall briefly state the purpose of the system to which this deliverable applies. It shall describe the general nature of the system and software; summarize the history of system development, operation, and maintenance; identify the project sponsor, acquirer, user, developer, and support agencies; identify current and planned operating sites; and list other relevant documents.

children.title: Document Overview
children.content: This section shall summarize the purpose and contents of the deliverable and shall describe any security or privacy considerations associated with its use.

children.title: Software size (planned vs. actual or delta size report)
Build Release Indicators
children.content: This metric is for reporting functionality change based upon incremental builds. Each build will contain the final content as directed by the Government.
